title: The Battle at Merom and the Conquest of Hazor
description: The kings of the north, led by Jabin of Hazor, gather at the waters of Merom with a large army, horses, and chariots to fight against Israel. The Lord promises victory, and Joshua attacks suddenly and defeats them. He then captures Hazor, burns the city, and destroys the kings and peoples in the region as Moses had commanded.
